lines.1: 「Hey, you're in the way standing frozen there.」
lines.4: 「Morning. Quite a commotion first thing, Sato.」
lines.8: 「How many times do I have to introduce myself!?」
lines.10: Wow. The Princess could not look less interested.
lines.11: 「Remembering people's names is basic courtesy. That's just common sense, right?」
lines.12: 「What do I gain by remembering the name of someone who isn't even in my class?」
lines.14: 「If you want me to remember your name, do something that burns it into my memory, Kondo-san.」
lines.16: 「...Sato. You're such a serious person. Why are you friends with someone like this?」
lines.17: 「And you're even chatting happily with rotten Tsushima.」
lines.18: Whoa. Now I'm catching stray fire too.
lines.19: 「What's all this noise first thing in the morning?」
lines.21: 「Murata! Not one character of that was right!」
lines.24: 「The weaker the dog, the louder it barks.」
lines.26: 「You there! What are you doing in front of the school gate!?」
lines.27: The iron disciplinarian arrived and brought the situation under control.
